construction.implementation_origin: Original reference implementation authored within this isolated build

input.synthetic: Must be true; all example identifiers and data are synthetic
input.as_of: Timezone-aware ISO 8601 reference date; no wall-clock dependency
input.products: Array of unique {id, category, popularity}; popularity finite in [0,1]
input.feedback: Array of unique {id, customer_id, product_id, text, severity}; severity low/medium/high/critical
input.events: Array of unique {id, customer_id, product_id, kind, timestamp}; kind view/purchase; timestamps no later than as_of

shared_schema.pipeline_envelope: {schema_version, status, input, sentiment, personalization}; both results initially null, then sentiment filled, then personalization filled
shared_schema.sentiment: One provenance-preserving record per feedback, including category, score, label, matches, is_issue and priority
shared_schema.personalization: One {id, cold_start, recommendations} per customer; recommendation has id, category, score, base_score, issue_penalty, issue_ids, item_affinity, category_affinity, popularity
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate(envelope, phase) boundary called before and after stages; exact field sets, references, unique IDs, date constraints, finite ranges, evidence arithmetic, provenance, handoff penalties and stable ordering checked
shared_schema.errors: CLI prints one JSON object {status: error, error: message} and returns 2 on file, JSON, schema or validation errors; success prints one complete envelope and returns 0
shared_schema.json: Duplicate object keys and NaN/Infinity rejected

cross_stage_handoffs.validated_output: Shared envelope with validated source data and completed sentiment records
cross_stage_handoffs.effect: Every candidate in a customer's issue category receives maximum issue priority / 200 as a penalty, capped by construction at 0.5. Other customers and categories are unaffected. Explanations carry originating feedback IDs.

behavior.sentiment: Lowercase ASCII word tokens; positive lexicon good/great/love/excellent/helpful/happy, negative bad/broken/hate/poor/terrible/slow. Immediately preceding not/never/no flips contribution. Average matched contributions, rounded to six places; no matches means neutral.
behavior.issues: An issue is negative sentiment or high/critical declared severity. Nonissues have priority zero. Issue priority = severity ordinal * 20 + max(0, -sentiment) * 20; ordinal low=1 through critical=4. Sort descending priority, then feedback ID.
behavior.recency: Event weight = (view:1, purchase:3) * 2^(-age_days/30). Sum by product and category, normalize each by its maximum for the customer.
behavior.ranking: With history, base = 0.7*item_affinity + 0.3*category_affinity. Without positive effective history, base = supplied catalog popularity. Final = max(0, rounded base - rounded issue penalty), rounded to six places.
behavior.cold_start: Explicit flag when no positive effective event weight exists, including numerically underflowed ancient histories. Feedback-derived penalties still apply.
behavior.ties: Descending final score, descending catalog popularity, then ascending product ID
behavior.edge_cases: Empty catalog/customers/feedback/events accepted when references remain valid. At most top_k products. Previously purchased products remain eligible. Repeated issues use max severity-aware priority, not a cumulative penalty.
behavior.determinism: Explicit as_of; deterministic event summation and sorting; no input mutation; no randomness or external service

included: Synthetic fixtures and standard-library unit/CLI tests
excluded: LLM or injected model step; neither is needed
